note: Geometry for the ab-wheel Shorts. Source is Muhammad Arsalan's finished 16:9 cut, so unlike earlier batches the frame ALREADY carries burned graphics: a top-centre pill (rows 55-185, x 200-1795) on the beginner/intermediate/advanced beats, and an olive lower third (one line rows 805-970, two lines rows 745-950, x 355-1565) elsewhere. Everything below is measured off full-resolution frames, not estimated.

talk.zoomNote: zoom:true crops 740 of the 1080 source rows from the TOP, dropping his lower third entirely. 740 is set by the TWO-LINE lower third (top edge row 745 at 0:22 and 1:35), not the one-line version at row 805 - one number for every zoom shot beats two. Costs 2.6x upscale against 1.78x for a full-height crop, which is why only the three talking-head shots that actually carry a lower third use it; a horizontal ab-wheel rollout under a lower third is a card instead.

card.note: STAGE, not the 1000x562 postage stamp V2/V3 used. This batch is card-heavy by necessity (the ab-wheel rollout is horizontal), so the card had to stop being an inset. Full canvas width, 830 tall, top edge y=170: the ASS caption band (MarginV 690) starts around y1015, and the stage fills everything above it. The title overlays the top of the stage for its 3.2s on a scrim baked into the title PNG - the same relationship a title has with a full-bleed talking head - rather than being squeezed into a strip above it. With a per-shot cardCrop that drops the dead sky and pool this carries ~2.4x the area of the old box.

audio.note: The source is SCORED - a music bed runs the whole 6:58 and it swells. A hard in-point drops the viewer into the middle of a bar and a hard out-point stops it dead, and an internal splice jumps the bed. Fades at the head and tail and a 60 ms dip either side of every internal join. Durations are preserved exactly (no acrossfade), so picture and sound stay locked.
